name: TAPNET AI Chatbot
author: TAPNET

sections.description:
TAPNET AI Chatbot connects a WordPress site to the TAPNET AI Website Chatbot service using an install token from your TAPNET account.

The plugin does not include the chatbot AI service locally. It loads the TAPNET chatbot service after a site administrator enables the plugin and saves a valid install token.

Use it to add a TAPNET-powered website chatbot that can answer visitor questions, collect lead details, and route conversations through TAPNET Lead Engine.

External service disclosure

This plugin connects to the TAPNET service at https://account.tapnet.com.

When the chatbot is enabled, the plugin loads a TAPNET script from:

https://account.tapnet.com/modules/addons/tapnet_assistant/assets/site-loader.js

The script resolves the saved install token with:

https://account.tapnet.com/modules/addons/tapnet_assistant/api/site-install.php

The chatbot may send the following data to TAPNET so the service can respond to visitors and create lead records:

  • Install token
  • Page URL and referring URL
  • Visitor chat messages
  • Visitor name, email, or phone number when voluntarily entered in the chat
  • Basic browser request metadata normally sent with web requests

A TAPNET account, active TAPNET service, and website install token are required.

Terms of service: https://tapnet.com/terms-of-use/

Privacy policy: https://tapnet.com/privacy-policy/

Footer credit

The chatbot can display a TAPNET footer credit/link only if the site administrator explicitly enables the optional TAPNET Footer Credit setting. This option is off by default, and the chatbot works without displaying a public credit link.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/tapnet-ai-chatbot, or install the plugin zip from the WordPress admin plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > TAPNET AI Chatbot.
  4. Paste the Website Install token from TAPNET Lead Engine.
  5. Check Enable Chatbot.
  6. Save the settings and refresh the public website.
sections.faq:
Do I need a TAPNET account?

Yes. This plugin connects WordPress to the TAPNET AI Website Chatbot service and requires an active TAPNET account and install token.

Does the plugin contact external servers?

Yes. After the site administrator enables the chatbot and saves an install token, the plugin loads TAPNET service scripts from account.tapnet.com and sends chatbot conversation data to TAPNET so the chatbot can respond.

Does the plugin add a TAPNET link to my website?

Only if you opt in. The TAPNET Footer Credit setting is off by default.

What happens if my TAPNET subscription is inactive?

The TAPNET service will not return an active chatbot configuration, and the widget will not load.

Can I hide the chatbot on specific pages?

Yes. Add one path per line in the Hide On Paths setting.
